summary: Full-stack testing of Saltbread home-baker app (Expo + FastAPI). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (100%) covering auth/login/register/me, product CRUD + seeded 7 variants, order create with server-side pricing + status flow (pending->in_progress->completed sets completed_at), expenses categories validation + filter + delete, and dashboard summary shape/derivations. Frontend: Login screen renders with demo credentials shown, sign-in navigates to /dashboard which renders all four KPIs (Revenue, Expenses, Profit, Active PO), 7-day trend chart, top-selling variants and expenses-by-category empty states. Tab navigation works: Orders shows filter chips (All/Pending/In Progress/Completed/Cancelled) + FAB + empty state; Expenses shows Total, category filter chips (All/Raw Materials/Packaging/Transport/...) + FAB + empty state; Products grid shows all 7 seeded variants with IDR prices; tapping a product opens edit modal prefilled with name/price/image URL/active toggle.

ui_bugs.issue: FAB is visually present and functional but lacks a stable testID (expected 'orders-fab')
Tab labels are used via text selectors (Dashboard/Orders/Expenses/Products); consider adding testID like 'tab-orders' etc. for robust automation

issues: Console deprecation warnings: shadow* style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only, no functional impact on preview.

action_items: Optional: add testID props to FABs (orders-fab, expenses-fab), tab bar items (tab-dashboard/tab-orders/tab-expenses/tab-products), and modal close/save buttons for more robust future automation.
Optional cleanup: replace deprecated RN Web style props (shadow* -> boxShadow, pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents) to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is referenced inside startup() before logging.basicConfig runs (basicConfig is at bottom of file). At module load logger is defined at the bottom, but the seed log call in startup uses the module-level 'logger' which is created after app.include_router; since startup runs after full module load this works, but ordering is fragile.
server.py: EXPENSE_CATEGORIES validation is case-sensitive. UI must send exact strings (currently does).
server.py: dashboard endpoint fetches up to 5000 orders/expenses and computes trend in Python; will not scale but fine for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows render; only missing testIDs on FAB/tab bar)

seed_data_creation: None. Backend auto-seeds 7 variants and demo user baker@saltbread.com/baker123 on startup. Test cases create+cleanup their own TEST_ prefixed products/orders/expenses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://home-baker-dashboard.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Login with baker@saltbread.com / baker123 to get bearer token. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_saltbread_api.py is the reusable regression suite. Frontend testIDs available: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button. Other screens rely on text selectors currently.
